title: HAAN: A Holistic Approach for Accelerating Normalization Operations in Large Language Models
problem: Normalization operations (LayerNorm) in LLMs substantially elevate processing latency and energy consumption, becoming a performance bottleneck.
motivation: LayerNorm is ubiquitous across all LLM layers for training stability and convergence; optimizing it yields significant system-level performance gains.
method: Algorithm-hardware co-design approach (HAAN) jointly optimizes normalization computation and hardware implementation to reduce latency and energy consumption.
key_novelty: Holistic co-design methodology specifically targeting normalization acceleration in LLM inference.
contributions: Significantly better hardware performance than state-of-the-art solutions
limitations: Specific performance metrics and speedup numbers not detailed in abstract.
